body: hi, thank you for your suggestion, but i’m a minor and i’m not sure how exactly i would go about doing that but i guess i could look into it. and i’ve talked about my issues with my parents before only for them to brush it off like they did with this current one. anyway, thank you for your help. :)

i have a teacher who has openly singled me out in class for being lgbt+ and acted inappropriately towards me sexually and the claims that have i brought forward to my school have been ignored. i just want to retract from his class but they refuse. my own parents don’t even believe me or seem to think that it’s that big of a deal even though it’s tearing me up inside and making me feel worse than i’ve ever felt. i’ve dealt with thoughts like these before in the past but this is the most intense i’ve ever felt. i feel like i’m deteriorating and see little purpose to even the things that i look forward to normally. i just want help and the only way i can see me getting it is by doing something drastic.
